author: claude-opus-5-5
visual_review: Reviewed at 48px and 384px in light and dark: boxy body with rounded top corners, front cabin with sloping windshield, two wheels that the body sides and sill meet tangentially at shared nodes; no open ends or pinches.
omissions: Wheel hubs dropped: a hub needs 8 units inside the rim, which would need wheels taller than the body allows. Cabin placed clearly forward so the drawing is deliberately asymmetric (the symmetry gate rejects near-mirrors).
